g.text: Region: London (eu-west-2) | Node.js 24 | Bedrock Nova Micro in-region | CloudFront global
Web app: plain JavaScript, no framework
Operations: IAM roles + Secrets Manager + CloudWatch alarms + runbook. DNS / HTTPS: Route 53 + ACM.
Delivery: AWS CDK / CloudFormation -> staging checks -> production. See the AWS notes for exact settings and failure handling.
Dashed amber: sources not supplied yet, used only when they exist. Unknown facts are flagged, never invented. Responses are omitted from arrows.
